title: Inter should bench Lautaro vs Parma — 48 hours home | Calhanoglu back in the group
description:
Inter should bench Lautaro against Parma — TyC Sport says he lands about 48 hours before kickoff.
https://www.nerazzurridaily.com/go/yt/?ed=36

Blue means the club said it. Pink means only the papers did.

REPORTED · TyC Sport via FCInter1908 · Oct 6 — Lautaro Martinez has some 11,000 km to travel home from Argentina and lands in Milan roughly 48 hours before kickoff, which the report calls close to impossible for a start. Seven matches in 21 days follow Saturday.
CONFIRMED · Inter.it · Oct 6 — Hakan Calhanoglu was in the group the club listed at Appiano Gentile on Tuesday. John Stones is not among the names.
CONFIRMED · Parma Calcio · Oct 6 — Pontus Almqvist has a low-grade tear in his left calf and will not play on Saturday. No return date was given.
REPORTED · Gazzetta dello Sport via FCInter1908 · Oct 6 — Inter's first choice in defense last summer was Trevoh Chalobah, who went to Como. Mario Gila was never pursued.
